translations.web: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
translations.bsb: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
translations.kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
translations.asv: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.
